about: What an agent asks before it writes anything. Each query is a plain-language request; `accept` lists substrings of a result's title or where-to-read-more line, any one of which means the right place was found in the top results. Keep the queries honest: written the way a request is phrased, not the way the docs are.

queries.q: add a door that opens with a key
add a countdown timer that ends the game
collect five items then open the exit
player has health and takes damage from enemies
respawn at a checkpoint after dying
spawn enemies over time but not too many
collect artifacts, activate a generator, survive, then escape
how do I test that my game mechanic works
make the camera follow the player in 2d
a boss that is a 3d model in a 2d game
play music that changes with the time of day
make a map with two rooms and a door
